notes: Switchports: the Network Switch window draws the switch's front panel live (Port speed, Uplink speed, Stack member, 12 ports, blue chassis); Connect to Switchport picks the port when a cable reaches a switch or a rack holding switches; Excel Switch Port Map tab and Start / Finish Port columns
